parties: Vipulkumar Arvindbhai Patel; Scoda Tubes Limited
headline: Scoda Tubes Limited: SEBI Regulation 31(4) Substantial Acquisition Disclosure
sum: Vipulkumar Arvindbhai Patel filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE, indicating substantial acquisition of shares in Scoda Tubes Limited triggering public disclosure obligations under the SEBI Takeover Regulations.
implication: Regulation 31(4) disclosure gates further acquisition steps and establishes public record of >5% voting threshold breach; acquirer must now comply with open offer timeline and pricing rules.
detail: The disclosure under SEBI (SAST) Regulations 2011 Regulation 31(4) indicates Vipulkumar Arvindbhai Patel has crossed the 5% threshold of voting shares in Scoda Tubes Limited, a publicly listed industrial tubes manufacturer. Regulation 31(4) requires mandatory disclosure of substantial acquisition to the stock exchange and public. No transaction value, timing, or consideration structure is publicly available at this stage.
